items.headline: Greed falls to 68 while Valuation remains 87
items.summary: Greed is 68/100, down 9 points daily, while Valuation remains 87/100. Regime is Correction and condition remains PRICE_DISCIPLINE.
items.whyItMatters: Cooling sentiment improves selective-entry optionality, but extreme valuation still argues against chasing broad beta.

items.headline: Treasury 10Y moves above 5% ahead of the Fed
items.summary: Reuters reported the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield above 5%, its highest since 2007, while markets priced about a 92.5% probability of a 25 bp Fed hike on September 16. Barron's highlighted rising yields, oil and AI anxiety in its September 15 Daily.
items.whyItMatters: The discount rate has risen further for long-duration equities, real estate and long bonds. Keep duration staggered and require larger margins of safety.

items.headline: Saudi pipeline remains offline as Hormuz traffic drops again
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remained offline while commodity traffic through Hormuz fell to four vessels on Monday and fresh regional attacks continued.
items.whyItMatters: The energy shock remains physical and multi-route, sustaining upside risk to crude, diesel, freight, insurance and inflation.

items.headline: AI risk repricing persists without confirmed demand collapse
items.summary: Barron's highlighted another AI-linked technology selloff. Reuters reported continued investor concern after industry leaders called for slowing AI development, while the effect on contracted compute demand remains uncertain.
items.whyItMatters: Keep separating safety and regulatory sentiment from independently financed demand, utilization, margins and free cash flow.

items.headline: Global government borrowing costs reach post-2008 highs
items.summary: Reuters reported average 10-year government yields across the G7 at 4.285%, the highest since mid-2008, with the U.S. benchmark above 5%.
items.whyItMatters: The higher hurdle rate is global and increases refinancing pressure on leveraged real estate and long-duration assets.
